Buttons & links

One gold fill per screen (Law 2). Everything else is a hairline button, a gold link or an icon button. Touch sizes lift to 44 px.

Dark · obsidian (default)
Primary — the one gold plane
Secondary, disabled, danger
Links, icon buttons, keys

Switches — the selected segment is a tint, never a fill
